name: AMENDMENT_A1
reason: 2026-10-05 engineering amendment 1 of 2 (before the dependent fidelity check is rerun; no bank fit has run). Demonstrated defect: stage_fidelity's frozen-minibatch equivalence used the first minibatch of epoch 2, on which (seed 0, RAW-J beta 0.3, epoch-2 snapshot critics) the constant predictor won on every view, so p_i = 0 for both encoders and the algebra check was vacuous (applicable = 0, receipt fid__s0__RAW-J_b0.3 kept in quarantine). Fix: use the first minibatch of epoch 2 in the salt-0 order on which both proxy gradients are nonzero (bounded scan; skipped batches recorded). Raw fidelity itself passed (bitwise model and critics vs pinned rgj, logged norms within 4.3e-7). Training code is unchanged.
